textbook: Clean semi-flat medical-illustration diagram in the EXACT house style of the plates rod-bacterium__textbook and parasite__textbook: a MUTED, sophisticated, slightly desaturated educational palette of soft dusty tints (NEVER bright primary or cartoon colours), THIN clean outlines (NOT heavy black cartoon strokes), gentle soft shading with subtle dimensionality, and a distinct soft colour fill for every structure. Refined and elegant, NOT a bold-outlined flat cartoon, and NOT a monochrome uncoloured line drawing. Subject: ONE single upright conidiophore of the mould Penicillium chrysogenum, seen from the side, occupying the centre of the frame. From a horizontal mat of pale translucent ivory SEPTATE hyphae along the lower third - thin threads with clearly drawn darker teal-grey cross-walls (septa) at regular intervals and a fine dusty-ochre wall outline - one hypha turns upward as a long, smooth, straight, hyaline STALK (conidiophore) with two or three septa of its own. At the very top the stalk does NOT swell: it BRANCHES symmetrically, first into two or three short branches (rami), then into whorls of slightly longer pale-sage branch cells (metulae), and each metula carries a whorl of two or three small warm-cream FLASK-SHAPED phialides with narrow tapered necks. Out of each phialide neck grows ONE long, straight, UNBRANCHED CHAIN of small round sage-green to blue-green spores (conidia), the chains splaying outward and upward so the whole head reads unmistakably as a fanned-out PAINTBRUSH. A few loose conidia drift in the empty space beside the chains. Absolutely NO swollen round vesicle, knob or ball at the top of the stalk (that is Aspergillus and is WRONG); no sac, bag, sporangium or capsule containing spores; no branched chains; no rhizoids or stolons; no mushroom cap, stem or gills; no ovoid budding yeast cell; no bacterial features; no chloroplasts. No face, no anthropomorphism, no Petri dish, pills, bread or props. Square 1:1, 1080x1080, single specimen centered with generous negative space around each structure so labels can attach, filling the whole frame edge-to-edge with NO black border, frame, vignette or letterbox bars and NOT drawn as a sheet on a surface. Neutral dark charcoal uncluttered background. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, labels, scale bars, arrows or watermarks baked into the image.
